[FACT] User has been cooking at home more frequently over the past three weeks.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new recipe ideas for chicken breasts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipe ideas for chicken breasts include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Korean-Style BBQ Chicken: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, and gochujang; grill or pan-fry; serve with kimchi and rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Indian Butter Chicken: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, and cumin; grill or bake; serve with a rich tomato-based sauce and basmati rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Japanese Teriyaki Chicken: Glaze chicken with sweet soy sauce, sake, and mirin; grill or pan-fry; serve with steamed vegetables and rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cajun Chicken: Season chicken with paprika, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, and thyme; pan-fry with onions and bell peppers; serve with crusty bread.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chipotle Lime Chicken: Marinate chicken in lime juice, olive oil, chipotle peppers, and cumin; grill or pan-fry; serve with roasted vegetables and warm tortillas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Spicy Korean Fried Chicken: Double-fry chicken in a spicy Korean chili flake-infused batter; serve with pickled radishes and kimchi.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Lemon Rosemary Chicken: Zest a lemon and mix with olive oil, garlic, and chopped rosemary; brush on chicken and roast with potatoes and carrots.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Bacon Wrapped Chicken: Wrap chicken with bacon and bake with a honey mustard glaze.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Chicken Cordon Bleu: Stuff chicken with ham, Swiss cheese, and herbs; bread and fry until crispy.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Peruvian-Style Grilled Chicken: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, garlic, and aji amarillo peppers; grill and serve with grilled corn and avocado salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 11. Southeast Asian-Style Grilled Chicken: Marinate chicken in fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes; grill and serve with sticky rice and fresh herbs.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 12. Mexican-Style Grilled Chicken: Marinate chicken in lime juice, olive oil, and chili powder; grill and serve with grilled onions, bell peppers, and warm tortillas.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the Korean-Style BBQ Chicken and Spicy Korean Fried Chicken ideas.
